reports.title: Big Lazer Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth bass fishing is fair right now. Fish plastic worms in deeper water and around structure. Try fishing these baits slower than normal in the cooler waters. Fishing the timber around the island may produce decent bites. Bream fishing is also just okay this time of year. Spawning is complete, so the bream fishing is beginning to slow some. Live bait such as crickets and worms should give you the best chance to catch a nice bream. Try fishing in woody brush 5-10 ft deep under a cork. Artificial bait such as beetle spins may also be a good choice to entice a bite. For catfish, try fishing chicken liver or shrimp in deeper water near the bottom. reports.title: Chattahoochee And Flint River fishing report
reports.text: Water temperatures in the rivers are down with the cool nights we have been having, and bass fishing is picking up! Fly fishing on the Flint River targeting shoal bass is a lot of fun and a unique activity specific to southwestern Georgia.

reports.title: Lake Walter F George fishing report
reports.text:
According to Ken Sturdivant at Southern Fishing, bass fishing is fair. The bass are like they were half and half on the shallow stuff and on the ledges.
The cooler weather has the crappie biting as well, with reports of limits mostly being caught on minnows.

reports.title: Lake Seminole fishing report
reports.text:
According to Ken Sturdivant at Southern Fishing, bass fishing has been fair. Suspending bass are located just off main lake or river points in 15 to 20 feet of water.

reports.title: Lake Blackshear fishing report
reports.text: The crappie bite is on fire right now. Anglers are fishing in 11- 18 ft of water and recommend Crappie Mayhem jigs or minnows on slip corks; get the gold ones from Flint River Outdoors, LLC.

reports.title: River Report fishing report
reports.text: Greg Shields fished the flooded Satilla River on Monday and caught a few bass out in the woods off the river. He used a Creek Boat and caught the bass in areas that are normally dry. Greg also fished the Altamaha on Tuesday and caught a total of 13 bass (up to 4 pounds) while using a buzzbait with a gold blade. He lost a bass that probably weighed around 6- 7 lbs. An angler fished the Satilla earlier this month and reported that he caught a nice mess of bass and panfish.

reports.title: Lakes And Ponds fishing report
reports.text: Georgia Public Fishing Areas: Two Waycross area anglers fished at a pond this week and caught 5 bass and a bowfin while using soft plastics. Ken Burke fished at Ocmulgee Public Fishing Area on two mornings and caught 7 bass total. Another angler reported catching 5 bass in the 3-4 lbs class one day at Ocmulgee PFA. Dean Barber and his son James had a good day fishing and caught several bass on Lake Trestle at Paradise Public Fishing Area this past Friday. A few anglers, fishing at Bidd Sands Lake, have reported decent numbers of bass and bluegill, all on live bait.
